# Donate

### SUPPORT NEWS YOU TRUST

States Newsroom is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit news operation that depends on support from people like you to produce high-quality journalism without paywalls, popups or ads.

Please help us with this public service. Your donations allow us to shine a light on state governments across the country.

Your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent of the law. Donors of $500 or more will be listed on our [Supporters page.](/support)

Manage your donation preferences [here](/donor-support).

To donate via check, please make it out to “States Newsroom”. Mail to:

States Newsroom,  
50 F St. NW, Ste 460,  
Washington, DC 20001

If you're giving to a specific newsroom, please note that in the memo line.

We take donor security seriously. We use industry-leading Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) and Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) technology to keep your personal information as secure as possible. We also help to protect your information by only working with PCI Compliant partners that provide a secure and safe environment for credit card donations to occur. Your card information is securely transmitted directly to those partners without it passing through our servers. The donation process is fully encrypted using industry best practices to ensure your personal and credit card information is kept private and secure throughout the donation.
